description: Pre-start checks complete. Glass check sheet signed.
Glass breakage detected in filler. Bottle shattered at the discharge star wheel.
action_taken: Emergency stop pressed. Machine locked out before any guard was opened. Quality lead called.

description: All bottles filled 10:12-10:42 put on QA HOLD (about 3,600 bottles). 14 open bottles within 2 metres of the break thrown away.
action_taken: QA HOLD labels fitted to 4 pallets.

description: Glass cleaned up with the red glass kit and vacuum. No compressed air used. Sanitation rinse 10 minutes done.
Quality lead inspected the filler and signed off restart.
Held bottles inspected. 3,580 released, 20 rejected. Broken bottle came from a chipped batch from the bottle supplier.
action_taken: Supplier complaint raised for the chipped batch.

description: One glass breakage handled by the book. About 1 hour lost.
action_taken: Watch for chipped bottles from the same supplier batch.
